title: How to upload a rpg maker xp game to the internet?

posts.author: elizabethafton
posts.body: Like ik the site I wanna upload it in, but I don't know how will I upload it, like, how do I make the file not edit-able? how do I make it just the game? what do I do to the file?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You deploy it (that's the terminology in the newer makers, presuming it might be the same in XP).
It should be right in your file menu, should also be right in one of the first topics of the instructions.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
I believe the command is "Compress Game Data" in XP, and you have the option to check a box for "create encrypted archive." That will compress it all down into a .exe. When you run the .exe, it'll extract into a folder that looks something like this:
(though without the save file XD)
Your graphics folder won't be visible, and it's certainly not bulletproof, but it's enough to stop a casual tamperer.
You can also compress the game data
without
creating an encrypted archive--I haven't done it in a while, but I believe that means it will extract into a folder that looks basically like your regular project folder.
